Explore Graduate Admissions
Find Your Program
From Accounting to Theatre and everything in between, Montclair offers a graduate program designed to fit your interests and goals. Learn online, on-campus or through a blend of both – the choice is yours.
Explore Graduate Programs
Attend an Event
Our events are open to students of all graduate programs – online, hybrid or in-person. Join us at an upcoming session to engage with faculty and staff, explore program details, and discover the many opportunities that Montclair offers.

New Program Spotlight
Health Analytics Certificate (Online)
Turn healthcare data into insights that can improve decisions, outcomes and operations with Montclair’s online Health Analytics Certificate. This 12-credit program brings together expertise in public health, business and computing while building practical skills in healthcare data analysis and informatics.
Designed for working professionals and current graduate students, the fully online, asynchronous format can be completed in approximately one academic year. Explore how this specialized credential can strengthen your skill set and prepare you to make a data-informed impact across the healthcare industry.
